workoutTabs.name: Chest for Size
workoutTabs.description: This goal is about making the chest muscle bigger, so it takes up more space and gives the front of the upper body more fullness. Success shows up as a chest that looks thicker from the front and the side, and fills a shirt more.

days.name: Chest for Size
days.description: This goal is about making the chest muscle bigger, so it takes up more space and gives the front of the upper body more fullness. Success shows up as a chest that looks thicker from the front and the side, and fills a shirt more.

workoutTabs.name: Chest for Strength
workoutTabs.description: This goal is about how much force the chest can produce, so you can push heavier weight than before. It's measured by what you can lift rather than by how the chest looks. A strong chest isn't always a visibly bigger one.

days.name: Chest for Strength

workoutTabs.name: Chest for Definition: upper edge
workoutTabs.description: This goal is about a clear line where the chest starts, just under the collarbone. A full upper chest makes a visible shelf there instead of a flat slope from neck to chest. Success is a top border you can see from the front, even in a fitted shirt.

days.name: Chest for Definition: upper edge
days.description: This goal is about a clear line where the chest starts, just under the collarbone. A full upper chest makes a visible shelf there instead of a flat slope from neck to chest. Success is a top border you can see from the front, even in a fitted shirt.

workoutTabs.name: Chest for Definition: lower edge
workoutTabs.description: This goal is about a crisp border along the bottom of the chest, where it meets the abs. A well-marked lower edge casts a slight shadow and separates the chest from the stomach. Success is a curved line along the bottom of each side of the chest, clear in normal light.

days.name: Chest for Definition: lower edge
days.description: This goal is about a crisp border along the bottom of the chest, where it meets the abs. A well-marked lower edge casts a slight shadow and separates the chest from the stomach. Success is a curved line along the bottom of each side of the chest, clear in normal light.

workoutTabs.name: Chest for Definition: side lines
workoutTabs.description: This goal is about the two vertical edges: the split down the middle of the chest and the outer edge toward the armpit. A visible middle split shows the two sides as separate shapes, and a clean outer edge frames the chest against the arms and ribs. Success is a chest whose width and centre line read clearly from the front.

workoutTabs.name: Biceps for Size
workoutTabs.description: This goal is about making the biceps and the muscle under them bigger, so the front of the upper arm looks thicker and fuller. Success shows up as arms that fill out sleeves more and show a fuller curve from shoulder to elbow.

days.name: Biceps for Size
days.description: This goal is about making the biceps and the muscle under them bigger, so the front of the upper arm looks thicker and fuller. Success shows up as arms that fill out sleeves more and show a fuller curve from shoulder to elbow.
